sources.title: GitHub - pagarcia/sam3-onnx-cpp: Segment Anything Model 3 C++ ONNX ...
sources.snippet: The rationale is practical portability. SAM3 has more export-sensitive internals than SAM2, especially around tracker attention and rotary position handling, so the repo avoids re-exporting working image artifacts and concentrates the custom ONNX work on the video tracker contracts. Python and C++ then consume the same artifacts without depending on PyTorch at demo time.

sources.title: [2511.16719] SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present Segment Anything Model (SAM) 3, a unified model that detects, segments, and tracks objects in images and videos based on concept prompts, which we define as either short noun phrases (e.g., "yellow school bus"), image exemplars, or a combination of both.
